Rising Beyond Standards: Our Journey of Recognition, Rankings, and Remarkable Achievements

360° LEARNING ECOSYSTEM

Your Growth, Our Priority: Empowering every student through a complete learning experience

EduRev: Education that transforms learning into real outcomes

Edu Rev goes beyond textbooks by bringing learning, earning, and growth together in one journey. With AI-personalised learning, gamified education, and research-driven assessments, it creates a smooth path from classroom learning to real-world application, while also enabling students to earn back a part of their semester fee.

Know More About EduRev

Bharat Innovation Challenge 2025-26 Grand Finale at LPU

LPU hosted the Bharat Innovation Challenge 2025-26, India's largest brain marathon, attracting 2,600 teams and 10,000+ participants from 28 states and 500+ cities. From 10 themes, 120 finalists presented prototypes, judged by 21 industry experts & leaders.

One World 2026: A Grand Celebration of Global Diversity

One World 2026, inaugurated by Abhishek Manu Singhvi, alongside H.E. Desire Boniface Some, Able Dungui Mavungo, and Mohamed Ali Mohamed Fazari, transformed the campus into a dynamic global hub, celebrating diversity, fostering connections, and showcasing how learning extends beyond classrooms into real-world global engagement.

Spectra 2026: A Grand Celebration of Youth & Talent

Spectra 2026 was held at LPU with vibrant enthusiasm, inaugurated by Dr. Ashok Kumar Mittal and Hon'ble Pro-Chancellor Col. (Dr.) Rashmi Mittal. Featuring 30+ categories, 2,000+ participants from 25 schools, and the EduRev Conclave, the festival celebrated creativity, competition, and student excellence.

LPU Shines at the 39th AIU Inter-University North Zone Youth Festival

LPU delivered an exceptional cultural performance, proudly securing the Overall First Runners-Up Trophy and marking yet another milestone in its journey of excellence on inter-university cultural platforms, inspiring young artists to dream big, perform bigger, and lead with creativity.

LPU Placement Day 2026: From Campus to Global Careers

Placement Day 2026 at LPU marked a defining moment as students transitioned from classrooms to global careers. With leading recruiters across technology, consulting, finance, analytics, engineering and innovation, the day showcased LPU's industry-focused education, student confidence and global readiness.

Jhanvi Dengati creates historic global milestone

Jhanvi Dengati becomes the first Indian selected for an elite geology field expedition in Husavik, Iceland, receiving Apollo-style lunar training and bringing global recognition to India and LPU.

SPOTLIGHT

Where a Dream Turns into Reality - Celebrating People, Passion, and Progress at LPU

Extra-Curricular

We cherished an unforgettable interactive session with Mr. Javed Akhtar, Padma Bhushan Awardee, Screenwriter, Lyricist, Poet and Social Activist. His words and experiences enlightened us to find joy in small things in life.

Youth Talk

We welcomed Wing Commander Vyomika Singh, the courageous officer behind the national briefing of Operation Sindoor. Her powerful message of fearless ambition, national service, and the impact of purpose-driven education left the #LPUFamily truly inspired.

Academics

LPU organised an inspiring Youth Talk featuring the remarkable Srikanth Bolla, renowned public speaker, entrepreneur, philanthropist, and CEO of Bollant Industries.

Youth Talk

We were honored to welcome incredibly talented and humble Bollywood actor, Vikrant Massey, to our campus. He gave a powerful message of always keeping oneself updated with the latest advancements in the field we are pursuing.

Youth Talk

The ever-radiant and beloved Shehnaaz Gill, actress, singer, and proud LPU alumna, returned to her home campus, and the celebration was nothing short of magical. The stage lit up with her unstoppable energy to laughing, dancing, and sharing heartfelt moments with students.

Concerts

The much-loved artist, Diljit Dosanjh, captivated the campus with an unforgettable concert that left everyone in awe. The night was filled with joy, laughter, and pure excitement, as he effortlessly connected with the crowd.

Youth Talk

The campus buzzed with excitement as Sonu Sood, actor, philanthropist, and real-life hero, graced an inspiring interaction. He shared his journey of compassion - from aiding thousands during the pandemic to empowering lives through health and education.

Concerts

Sunidhi Chauhan gave an electrifying performance during the Coke Studio Bharat Live Concert held at the campus. The students sang and danced along, fully immersed in the soulful renditions of their favourite songs.

Concerts

Farhan Akhtar's live performance at YouthVibe 2026 energized the audience with powerful music and engaging stage presence, making the night memorable with enthusiasm, entertainment, and a truly immersive musical experience.
